mostWorthwhile.text: Testing and adjusting the launcher was most worthwhile: the short launch exposed a clear problem, and the retest showed how extra spring travel helped reach the top arch.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the flippers and targets felt routine; both were the only offered combinations and revealed little about the fittings.

surprise.text: The adjustable stop made the top arch reachable by giving the spring more travel while keeping the push gentle.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the compatible-option menu made the sequence feel guided rather than discovered.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see what gets built next. The test-and-adjust sequence was satisfying and explained a useful mechanism, even if the choices were limited.
